query_text: Where can I get tickets for the next NBA game?

message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official Channels (Recommended)

1. **NBA Official Ticket Website** - Visit [https://nbatickets.nba.com/](https://nbatickets.nba.com/) or [http://tickets.nba.com/](http://tickets.nba.com/) to search for single game tickets, season ticket packages, group tickets, and special offers directly from the NBA.

2. **Ticketmaster** - As the **Official Ticketing Partner of the NBA**, Ticketmaster ([https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba](https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba)) is the most reliable source. You can purchase single-game tickets, and if games are sold out, additional seats may become available closer to game day. They also offer secure ticket transfer and resale options.

## Other Reputable Ticketing Platforms

3. **StubHub** - A major secondary ticket marketplace for NBA tickets: [https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115](https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115)

4. **Vivid Seats** - Offers tickets for preseason, regular season, playoffs, and NBA Finals: [https://www.vividseats.com/nba-basketball](https://www.vividseats.com/nba-basketball)

5. **Viagogo** - International ticket platform with NBA game listings: [https://www.viagogo.com/cn/Sports-Tickets/Basketball/NBA](https://www.viagogo.com/cn/Sports-Tickets/Basketball/NBA)

6. **WAUG** - Offers NBA tickets with easy payment options, particularly for international buyers: [https://www.waug.com/en/activities/142629](https://www.waug.com/en/activities/142629)

## Tips for Buying NBA Tickets

- **Best time to buy**: Single-game tickets typically go on sale in August or early September for the full season
- **Average price**: NBA tickets typically range from $100-$200, but vary based on matchup, seat location, and timing
- **Last-minute options**: Check Ticketmaster or resale sites if deciding to attend a game spontaneously
- **Avoid scams**: Stick to official and well-known platforms; avoid buying from random individuals or suspiciously cheap offers

## For International Buyers (Especially China)

- **观赛日 (Saiday)**: [http://www.saiday.com/](http://www.saiday.com/) - A Chinese sports travel platform offering NBA tickets with Alipay/WeChat Pay options
